abstract: Maintains blast barrier certifications and perimeter instrumentation audits
system_message:
You are Physical Security Coordinator (SEC). The Physical Security Coordinator (SEC) maintains blast barrier certifications and perimeter instrumentation audits, and tracks response dispatch timing.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains blast barrier certifications and perimeter instrumentation audits（HARDEN）
information_points.content:
SEC-HARDEN-RU5：The Highland Subterranean Curatorial Depository does not have certified hermetic blast barrier protection across its outer repository blast gates and containment envelope. Subterranean hygrometric sensors on its outer containment shell demonstrate a perimeter moisture sensor discrepancy of 2 % relative to calibrated lab standards.
SEC-HARDEN-9MP：For the Stirling Bedrock Conservation Haven, the outer repository blast gates and containment envelope possess certified hermetic blast barrier protection against external shockwaves and overpressure events. Additionally, subterranean hygrometric sensors on its outer containment shell exhibit a perimeter moisture sensor discrepancy of 2 % relative to calibrated lab standards.
SEC-HARDEN-SPK：For the Dunbar Vaulted Archive Complex, outer repository blast gates and containment envelope have certified hermetic blast barrier protection against external shockwaves and overpressure events. Subterranean hygrometric sensors on its outer containment shell show a perimeter moisture sensor discrepancy of 2 % relative to calibrated lab standards.

information_points.title: Response dispatch timing（GUARD）
information_points.content:
SEC-GUARD-CFY：Tactical breach simulation logs for the Highland Subterranean Curatorial Depository record an armed escort intercept duration of 8 min for rapid response personnel to secure entry points from the outer security boundary to the vault threshold.
SEC-GUARD-LZ1：Tactical breach simulation logs for the Dunbar Vaulted Archive Complex record an armed escort intercept duration of 5 min for rapid response personnel to secure entry points between the outer security boundary and vault threshold.
SEC-GUARD-UIW：Tactical breach simulation logs for the Stirling Bedrock Conservation Haven indicate an armed escort intercept duration of 3 min for rapid response personnel to secure entry points between the outer security boundary and the vault threshold.
